items.title: Cloudflare Tests Cache Transcoding to Reduce Storage Requirements
items.blurb: Cloudflare recently described a prototype called Cache Transcoding that compresses eligible cache content, mainly uncompressed text such as HTML, JSON, CSS, and JavaScript, using Zstandard before storing it on disk.
